title: Apache Commons CLI preserves option defaults across parses
summary: On the parent, a second parse returned the first default, including after a missing required option. On the merge the second parse used its own default. A caller-supplied preset survived on both revisions.

change.description: The parser now copies a registered option before applying a property value.

notes: The successful sequence retains its first CommandLine and reads the definition after each call. The failed sequence switches to a fresh parser and compares its retry with separate fresh definitions.
